Shots bounce off the side walls and stick to the eggs; three or more of one colour pop, and eggs no longer hanging from the ceiling fall for a bonus. Every [member shots_per_drop] shots the ceiling comes down a row. Emits [signal cleared] when the board is empty and [signal overflowed] when an egg reaches the bottom line (wire them to win() and lose() in the rules).

components.doc: A farm animal: wanders around where it was placed, and every [member product_seconds] has something to give (an egg, milk) that a [FarmerComponent] collects with interact. A speech bubble shows when it is ready. With [member needs_food] it first has to be fed (a hay bubble; interact feeds it), and again after each product. A young animal with [member grows_into] turns into that entity after [member grow_seconds].

components.doc: A farming season of [member days] days. Each day runs from 6:00 to 22:00 in [member day_seconds]; the light warms in the evening and goes dark at night. Sleeping (a [SleepSpotComponent] bed) ends the day early; at midnight the farmer drops off anyway. Overnight, watered crops grow and fed animals get their product ready. After the last day the season ends ([signal season_ended]).

components.name: FarmPlot

signals.doc: Emitted when the hoe turns the grass into soil.

signals.name: ripened

signals.name: harvested

signals.name: eaten

components.doc: A patch of soil for farming games. A [FarmerComponent] plants a crop here, waters it and harvests it when ripe. The crop only grows while the soil is wet, and the soil dries after [member water_seconds]. Pests ([CropPestComponent]) can eat what grows here.

components.name: FarmSave

params.name: slot
params.doc: Name of the save (one per game).

params.name: every
params.doc: Seconds between autosaves.

signals.name: restored
signals.doc: Emitted after a save was loaded.

components.doc: Keeps a farm between plays: the day and the time, the money, the basket, the tools, every plot, the animals and which trees and rocks are gone are written to user:// (the browser's storage on the web) each morning and every [member every] seconds. Opening the game again carries on where it was left; the save is deleted when the season is won or lost (or the player restarts with R), so the next game starts fresh. Put it on the farmer. Bots and recordings (the root's "sp_autopilot" mark) neither load nor save, so they always see a fresh farm and leave no save behind.

components.name: Farmer

params.name: crops
params.doc: The crops on offer (see the class description).

params.name: goods
params.doc: Prices of the other things the basket can hold (see the class description).

params.name: buy_seeds
params.doc: Seeds cost money (a third of the crop's price, at least $1), paid from the score when planting.

params.name: reach

params.name: basket_size
params.doc: Most crops the basket holds.

params.name: hotbar
params.doc: Show the hotbar (seed slots and the basket) at the bottom of the screen.

signals.name: sold
signals.doc: Emitted after a sale with the money earned.

signals.name: acted
signals.doc: Emitted after each action: "till", "plant", "water", "harvest", "feed", "collect", "chop", "gather", "cast", "catch", "sleep", "browse" or "upgrade".

components.doc:
The player's farming hands. Press interact (Space / E) next to something: grass where a plot goes is tilled with the hoe, an empty plot gets the selected seed, a growing one gets water, a ripe one is harvested into the basket; a [FarmAnimalComponent] gives its egg or milk; a [GatherableComponent] tree or rock takes a hit (and gives wood or stone when it breaks); at a [FishingSpotComponent] the first press casts and the next one, when a fish bites, reels it in. A hungry animal is fed first. Keys 1-9 choose the seed. Walk into a [MarketComponent] (a stall or a shipping bin) to sell the basket.
[member crops] is a ";"-separated list of "Name|#color|grow seconds|price", optionally followed by "|growth stages picture|icon picture" (res:// paths). [member goods] prices everything else the basket can hold: "Name|price|icon picture;..." (eggs, milk, wood, stone).

signals.name: caught
signals.doc: Emitted with the catch.

methods.name: bobber_position
methods.doc: Where the bobber floats.

components.doc: A place on the shore to fish from. A [FarmerComponent]'s interact casts the line (a bobber lands on the water in [member water_dir]); after a wait the fish bites (a "!" and a splash) and interact again reels it in. Too soon or too late and it gets away.

signals.name: escaped

components.doc: Flies its entity across the screen on a pattern (side-scrolling shooters). "straight" keeps its heading, "wave" swings up and down along it, "dive" turns toward the player's height while the player is still ahead, "hover" flies in, stops at [member hover_at] and bobs up and down (gunships and bosses). Drives a TopDownMovement body, or moves an Area2D directly at [member speed]. Leaves the screen quietly past the far edge.

components.name: GameMenu

params.name: title

components.doc: A title screen and a pause menu, and the background music. The game waits on the title screen until the player presses Space / Enter or taps; with a saved farm ([FarmSaveComponent]) it offers to carry on, and N starts a new one. P or Esc pauses (M turns the music on or off, R restarts). Bots, recordings and headless runs skip the title screen. Put it on the player.

components.doc: Game feel for one entity. Wires itself to whatever sibling components exist and adds feedback: squash & stretch on jump/land, white flash + shake + hit-stop when hurt, after-images on dash, particle bursts on death and pickup, recoil shake and sounds. Attached automatically to every entity unless the game disables juice.

components.name: LevelUpMenu

params.name: upgrades
params.default: Rapid Fire|Shoot 25% faster|Weapon.fire_rate*1.25;Multishot|One more projectile|Weapon.projectile_count+1,Weapon.spread_deg+10;Power|Bullets hit harder|Bullet:Hitbox.damage+1;Piercing|Bullets pass through one more enemy|Bullet:Projectile.pierce+1;Swift|Move 12% faster|TopDownMovement.max_speed*1.12;Vitality|+1 max health, fully healed|Health.max_health+1,Health.current+99;Magnet|Pull XP from further away|Experience.magnet_radius*1.5

params.name: max_picks

components.doc:
Survivor-style upgrade picker. On every level of the sibling [ExperienceComponent] the game pauses and offers [member choices] random upgrades as cards (keys 1-3, arrows + Enter, or a click).
[member upgrades] is a ";"-separated list of "Name|Description|changes". Each change is "[Entity:]Component.param" followed by "*factor" or "+amount"; several changes are joined with ",". Without "Entity:" the change applies to this entity; with it, to every current and future instance of that entity type (bullets, for instance).

components.doc: A market stall for farming games: a [FarmerComponent] that walks in sells everything in the basket.

params.doc: Initial jump speed (px/s). Jump height ≈ jump_velocity² / (2·gravity).

params.doc: Multiplies the project gravity for this entity.

params.doc: Extra gravity while falling — makes jumps feel weighty instead of floaty.

params.doc: Vertical speed is multiplied by this when jump is released while rising (short hop).

signals.name: jumped
signals.doc: Emitted when a jump starts (ground, coyote or air jump).

signals.name: landed

signals.name: dashed
signals.doc: Emitted when a dash starts.

methods.name: request_jump
methods.doc: Asks for a jump; it happens as soon as it is allowed (buffered).

methods.name: request_dash
methods.doc: Asks for a dash in the move / facing direction.

methods.name: bounce
methods.doc: Launches the entity upward (e.g. after stomping an enemy). Not cut by releasing jump.

methods.name: apply_knockback
methods.doc: Pushes the entity; player control is reduced briefly so the push is felt.

methods.name: is_dashing
methods.doc: True while dashing.

components.doc:
Side-view running and jumping tuned for good game feel.
Includes coyote time (jump shortly after leaving a ledge), jump buffering (press jump shortly before landing), variable jump height (release early for a short hop), stronger gravity when falling, a little hang time at the apex, snappy turning and an optional dash. Reads intent (move_vector, jump requests) from a controller such as PlayerInput or PatrolAI.

components.name: PlayerInput
components.doc:
Keyboard/mouse controller for the player. Writes intent into the movement component and pulls weapon triggers. Registers its own input actions, so no project setup is needed.
Default keys: move = WASD / arrows, jump = Space / Z / W / Up, dash = Shift / C / K, shoot = X / J / left mouse.

params.doc: Seconds before disappearing.

params.name: pierce
params.doc: Number of extra targets it passes through.

signals.name: expired
signals.doc: Emitted when the projectile disappears (wall, lifetime or last hit).

methods.name: expire
methods.doc: Removes the projectile now.

components.doc: Moves its entity in a straight line; disappears on walls, after its lifetime, or after hitting [member pierce] + 1 targets. Pair with a Hitbox to deal damage.

components.name: ShmupShip

params.name: max_power
params.doc: Highest power level.

params.name: auto_fire
params.doc: Fire without holding the button.

signals.name: powered
signals.doc: Emitted when the power level changes.

methods.name: power_up
methods.doc: One level stronger (a rule calls this when a power-up is collected).

components.doc: The player's ship in a side-scrolling shooter. It fires on its own toward the right, grows stronger with every power-up (more shots, a wider spread, a faster rate) and loses a level of power when it is hit.

components.name: Shop

params.name: offers
params.doc: What is for sale (see the class description).

params.name: rare_crop
params.doc: The rare crop the "seeds" offer adds, in the farmer's crop format ("Name|#color|seconds|price|stages|icon").

signals.name: bought
signals.doc: Emitted after a purchase with the offer's key.

components.doc:
A shop stall: interact once to see the next thing for sale, again (within a few seconds) to buy it. Sells animals (a new hen or cow walks into the pen), a rare crop's seeds (a new slot in the hotbar) and sprinklers (the next [SprinklerComponent] on the farm starts working).
[member offers] is a ";"-separated list of "key|Name|price"; keys: chicken, cow, seeds, sprinkler.

components.name: SleepSpot

signals.name: slept
signals.doc: Emitted when someone goes to sleep here.

components.doc: A bed: a [FarmerComponent]'s interact here sleeps until morning (see [FarmDaysComponent]).

components.name: Spawner

params.name: entity
params.doc: Entity type to spawn.

params.name: interval
params.doc: Seconds between spawns.

params.name: start_delay
params.doc: Seconds before the first spawn.

params.name: max_alive
params.doc: Do not spawn while this many spawned entities are alive.

params.name: total
params.doc: Total spawns before stopping (0 = unlimited).

params.name: radius
params.doc: Random offset radius around the spawner (px).

params.name: interval_ramp
params.doc: After each spawn the interval is multiplied by this (below 1 = waves get denser over time).

params.name: min_interval
params.doc: The interval never ramps below this (seconds).

params.name: around_player
params.doc: Above 0: spawn on a ring of this radius (px) around the player instead of at the spawner (enemies arriving from off-screen in survivor games).

signals.name: spawned
signals.doc: Emitted after each spawn with the new node.

methods.name: spawn_now
methods.doc: Spawns one entity immediately. Returns it (or null).

components.doc: Spawns entities at its position on a timer (enemy waves, portals, hazards).

components.name: Sprinkler

params.name: radius
params.doc: Plots closer than this are watered (px).

params.name: start_active
params.doc: Starts working without being bought.

components.doc: A sprinkler waiting to be bought (see [ShopComponent]): hidden until [method activate]; then every morning (and right away) it waters the plots within [member radius].

components.name: Stomp

params.name: damage
params.doc: Damage dealt by a stomp.

params.name: bounce_velocity
params.doc: Upward speed after a stomp (px/s). Holding jump does not add to it.

params.name: size_scale
params.doc: Stomp area size relative to the entity shape.

signals.name: stomped
signals.doc: Emitted after a successful stomp on [param target].

components.doc: Platformer "jump on their head" attack: landing on an enemy from above damages it and bounces this entity up. Grants a moment of invincibility so the enemy's contact damage does not trigger in the same frame.

components.name: ToolBench

params.name: offers
params.doc: Upgrades for sale (see the class description).

signals.name: bought
signals.doc: Emitted after a purchase with the upgrade's key.

components.doc:
A workbench that sells tool upgrades to a [FarmerComponent]. Interact once to see the next upgrade and its price, again (within a few seconds) to buy it; interacting after that shows the next one.
[member offers] is a ";"-separated list of "key|Name|price": keys are can (waters a 3x3 patch), hoe (tills a 3x3 patch), basket (8 more room), axe (two hits a swing) and rod (fish stay on the hook longer).

components.name: TopDownMovement

params.name: max_speed
params.doc: Top speed (px/s).

params.name: acceleration
params.doc: Acceleration toward the input direction (px/s²).

params.name: friction
params.doc: Deceleration when there is no input (px/s²).

params.name: dash_speed
params.doc: Dash speed (px/s). 0 disables dashing.

params.name: dash_duration
params.doc: Dash duration in seconds.

params.name: dash_cooldown
params.doc: Seconds between dashes.

signals.name: dashed
signals.doc: Emitted when a dash starts.

methods.name: request_dash
methods.doc: Asks for a dash in the movement (or facing) direction.

methods.name: apply_knockback
methods.doc: Pushes the entity; control is reduced briefly.

methods.name: is_dashing
methods.doc: True while dashing.

components.doc: Eight-direction movement seen from above, with acceleration, friction and an optional dash. Reads intent (move_vector, dash requests) from a controller such as PlayerInput or ChaseAI.

components.name: TowerBrain

params.name: fire_range
params.doc: Firing range in px.

components.doc: A defence tower's brain: aims its Weapon at the enemy furthest along the road within [member fire_range] and keeps firing while one is there.

components.name: TowerBuilder

params.name: towers
params.doc: The towers on offer (see the class description).

params.name: start_gold
params.doc: Gold at the start.

signals.name: built
signals.doc: Emitted after a tower is built.

components.doc:
The player's builder (tower defense): keys 1-3 pick a tower, a click or tap on a [TowerSlotComponent] builds it if the gold (score) covers the cost. Kills earn gold through the rules.
[member towers] is a ";"-separated list of "Entity|cost", e.g. "ArcherTower|50;CannonTower|100".

components.name: TowerSlot

params.name: size
params.doc: Pad size in px.

components.doc: A build pad beside the road (tower defense). A [TowerBuilderComponent] builds a tower here when the player clicks or taps the pad (or presses build while standing next to it).

components.name: TriggerZone

params.name: group
params.doc: Only bodies in this group trigger the zone ("player", an entity name, or "" for any).

params.name: once
params.doc: Trigger only the first time.

signals.name: triggered
signals.doc: Emitted when a matching body enters.

components.doc: An invisible-or-visible zone that fires [signal triggered] when an entity of [member group] enters (exit doors, checkpoints, kill zones, tutorial hints).

components.name: Warp

params.name: to
params.doc: Where the player arrives (world px).

params.name: hint
params.doc: The hint shown when the player steps in ("Enter", "Go out").

signals.name: warped
signals.doc: Emitted after the player went through.

components.doc: A doorway: while the player stands in this area, interact (Space / E) moves them to [member to] (a house's inside, and back out). The screen dips to black for a moment and the camera jumps along.

components.name: WaveSpawner

params.name: waves
params.default: 6 x Goblin every 1.5; 8 x Goblin every 1.0
params.doc: The waves (see the class description).

params.name: pause
params.doc: Seconds before the first wave and between waves.

params.name: spread_x
params.doc: Random offset (px, total range) added to where each enemy appears: side-scrolling shooters spread them along the edge.

params.name: spread_y
params.doc: Same, vertically (shooters send enemies in at random heights).

params.name: autostart
params.doc: Start sending waves right away. Off: waits for [method start] (a boss gate).

params.name: endless
params.doc: After the last wave start again, with bigger and faster waves, and never report [signal cleared].

signals.name: wave_started
signals.doc: Emitted when a wave starts; [param number] counts from 1.

signals.name: cleared
signals.doc: Emitted when every wave is done and the field is clear.

methods.name: start
methods.doc: Begins the waves (for a spawner created with autostart off).

components.doc: Sends waves of enemies from its entity (tower defense). [member waves] is a ";"-separated list of "count x Entity every seconds", e.g. "8 x Goblin every 1.2; 5 x Orc every 2". Emits [signal cleared] once every wave has been sent and no spawned enemy is left.

components.name: Weapon

params.name: projectile
params.doc: Entity type spawned as the projectile (must have a Projectile component).

params.name: fire_rate
params.doc: Shots per second.

params.name: spread_deg
params.doc: Random spread in degrees (total cone width).

params.name: projectile_count
params.doc: Projectiles per shot (shotgun when > 1, spread evenly over spread_deg).

params.name: muzzle_distance
params.doc: Spawn distance from the entity center (px).

params.name: auto_fire
params.doc: Fire continuously without input (enemies, turrets).

params.name: recoil
params.doc: Push applied to the shooter opposite to the shot (px/s). 0 = none.

signals.name: fired
signals.doc: Emitted every time the weapon fires.

methods.name: fire
methods.doc: Fires immediately (ignores the trigger, respects nothing else).

components.doc: Fires projectile entities. Aim comes from aim_direction (set by Aim or ChaseAI), otherwise from the movement facing. Projectiles inherit the shooter's team.

components.name: XpOrb

params.name: value
params.doc: XP given on pickup.

params.name: pull_speed
params.doc: Top speed when pulled by a magnet (px/s).

params.name: lifetime
params.doc: Disappears after this many seconds (0 = never).

signals.name: absorbed
signals.doc: Emitted when picked up; [param by] is the collecting entity.

components.doc: An experience gem dropped by defeated enemies. It drifts toward a player that has an [ExperienceComponent] once inside their magnet radius, then gives [member value] XP on touch.
